en.title: Illegal betting operation in 12 provinces: 22 suspects detained
en.summary: Gendarmerie conducted an operation against illegal betting across 12 provinces centered in Konya, detaining 22 suspects who were subsequently transferred to the judiciary.

en.title: Interior Minister Çiftçi announces: Namık Gedik's remains to be transferred to Menderes Memorial Cemetery
en.summary: The Interior Minister stated that former Interior Minister Namık Gedik will be commemorated as a victim of the 1960 coup, with his remains to be moved to a memorial cemetery.

en.summary: In the investigation into the disappearance of 11-month-old Büşra in Sivas, contradictory statements from parents and testimony from children have altered the direction of the inquiry.

en.title: Defense Ministry responds to Greece over Meis Island: 'Will not be accepted by Turkey'
en.summary: Turkey's Defense Ministry rejected Greece's actions regarding Meis Island, stating that military activities on the island violate its demilitarized status and international obligations.

en.title: Investigation into allegations of interfering with lawsuits in exchange for benefits: detention order for 6 suspects, including 2 lawyers
en.summary: Turkish authorities are investigating claims that an organized group illegally interfered with court cases in Istanbul in exchange for financial gain. Six suspects, including two lawyers, have been ordered detained.

en.title: Operation against criminal organization interfering with court files at courthouse: detention order for 6 people, 2 of them lawyers
en.summary: Bakırköy prosecutors announced an operation against a criminal group accused of interfering with court files at Istanbul courts. Detention orders were issued for six suspects, two of whom are lawyers.

en.title: Sharp decline in Borsa Istanbul covered by world media: what is happening in Turkish markets?
en.summary: A sharp market decline triggered by liquidity problems at a Turkish fund management company has drawn attention from international outlets including Financial Times, IntelliNews, and Reuters. The incident has renewed discussions about vulnerabilities in Turkey's financial markets.

en.summary: In an ongoing investigation into an 11-month-old girl missing for seven days in Sivas, a man named Mehmet K. has been detained in Diyarbakır based on statements from the child's siblings claiming he took her from their tent.

stories.title: Bakan Çiftçi duyurdu: Eski bakan Namık Gedik'in naaşı Menderes'in yanına taşınıyor

en.summary: Interior Minister Mustafa Çiftçi announced that the remains of former minister Namık Gedik will be relocated to be placed beside Adnan Menderes, in a statement issued on the 65th anniversary of the May 27 coup and executions.

stories.title: SON DAKİKA! MSB'den provokasyon peşinde koşan Yunanistan'a çok net mesaj! Dikkat çeken Meis Adası vurgusu: "Türkiye haklarını korumaya devam edecek"

en.title: Defense Ministry delivers strong message to Greece seeking provocation! Notable Meis Island emphasis: "Turkey will continue to protect its rights"
en.summary: Turkey's Defense Ministry issued a firm statement to Greece regarding militarization of islands and provocations, emphasizing Turkey's commitment to protecting its rights in the Aegean Sea and Eastern Mediterranean.

en.summary: Gendarmerie arrested 14 suspects operating a massive illegal gambling network involving 2.3 billion lira in financial activity across Tekirdağ and Istanbul, with 14 betting sites closed.
